name: Responses API — direct (no agent)
summary: POST /openai/v1/responses with model='{conn}/{deployment}' and no agent_reference.
description: `aoai.responses.create(model='{connection}/{deployment}', ...)` calls the Foundry project OpenAI Responses API without an agent wrapper. This is the baseline BYOM route that proves the APIM AI Gateway prefix works before layering Prompt Agents or tools on top.
notes:
Client-facing surface works, but Foundry down-converts every Responses call to Chat Completions before it reaches the upstream — the endpoint is not a true Responses passthrough.

**Client side (works).** `aoai.responses.create(model='{connection}/{deployment}', ...)` returns a valid response object. See `test.py`.

**Upstream translation (verified in APIM).** Two probe calls on 2026-07-17 (`aoai.responses.create(model='apim-...-openai-s/gpt-4o-mini', input='...')` and the same call with a top-level `instructions=` argument) both arrived at APIM as:

> `POST https://apim-ai-3swd46vd3j22a.azure-api.net/inference/deployments/gpt-4o-mini/chat/completions?api-version=2025-03-01-preview`

not `/responses`. Captured request body:

> `{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Today Date: 18 July 2026\n\nImage input capabilities: Enabled"}, {"type": "text", "text": "You are a marker echoer. Always reply with exactly the marker: APIMPROBE2ce055a92"}]}, {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "what is the marker?"}]}], "stream": true, "max_completion_tokens": 16384, "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}, "model": "gpt-4o-mini", "temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 1.0}`

What Foundry does to the request:
- Rewrites the path from `/openai/v1/responses` to `/inference/deployments/{deployment}/chat/completions`.
- Strips the `{conn}/` prefix from `model` in the body and moves the full prefix to a `x-ms-foundry-model-id` request header.
- Converts the Responses top-level `instructions=` into a `role: system` chat message.
- Injects an extra system message (`Today Date: … \n\n Image input capabilities: Enabled`).
- Forces `stream: true` and `max_completion_tokens: 16384` regardless of what the caller passed.

**Impact.** Any Responses-only field or feature the model needs to see natively — reasoning items, `previous_response_id`, `store`, `web_search_preview` / `computer_use_preview` tools, response-shape events — cannot round-trip through Foundry today. Callers relying on Responses semantics beyond a chat-shaped completion should treat this endpoint as "Chat Completions with Responses shape at the edge", not as a true Responses passthrough.

Still the control path for Prompt Agent tests: failures here point at the underlying Chat Completions upstream, while failures above it point at the agent or tool layer.
